title: capCell resolves behavior_change from the top-level field or the trace
action: Per E6, capCell at lib/cells.mjs:1830-1835 reads only the TOP-LEVEL cell.behavior_change, but cells are commonly authored with the value nested under trace.behavior_change -- so a genuine behavior change caps with the flag false. Live evidence: validation-diet cells vd-9, vd-10 and vd-11 all carry change_class 'behavior' and all capped with trace.behavior_change false; scribing-debt detection and the semantic goal-check judge tier both key off trace.behavior_change === true, so all three silently missed those obligations. Resolve from either location -- top-level wins when explicitly set, otherwise fall back to the trace value. Forward-only: do NOT retroactively correct already-capped cells; post-cap correction is refused by the tooling and rewriting capped records would falsify history. Serialize behind dch-1: both cells edit lib/cells.mjs, and your verify must still cover dch-1's registry warning so you cannot silently revert it. Twin moves in the same commit.

truths: A cell carrying only trace.behavior_change true caps with the flag true
A cell with an explicit top-level behavior_change keeps that value
dch-1's registry warning still fires after this change

artifacts.substantive: behavior_change resolved from either location at cap

key_links: the resolution happens once, at the cap read, not duplicated at each consumer
prohibitions: No retroactive edit of capped cell records
No removal or weakening of dch-1's warning
No change to what change_class means

verify: node packages/bee/tests/test_cells.mjs && node packages/bee/tests/test_cli_cells.mjs && node packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs

trace.outcome: capCell now resolves behavior_change from either the top-level cell field or trace.behavior_change (resolveDeclaredBehaviorChange), resolved once at the cap read; top-level explicit true/false wins, trace is the fallback. Forward-only, no retroactive correction of already-capped cells. Two new tests cover the trace-only and explicit-top-level-wins cases; dch-1's E1 registry-warning tests (4 assertions) stay green. packages/bee/lib/cells.mjs and .bee/bin/lib/cells.mjs stay byte-identical.
